description: Every token symbol on Arc worn by more than one contract, with how many contracts share it and the canonical address where one is verified. Identity is the contract, never the symbol. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_impostors
